# vision-engine
Deterministic integer-only vision core for visual QA: frames -> tile classes -> regions -> judge pack -> visual memory. Python 3.11+, numpy.
Start: AGENTS.md (ladder, layers, edit rules)
Route a task: python3 tools/route_code.py --q "<task>"
Gate: python3 tools/gates.py --all
- AGENTS.md
- README.md
- QUICKSTART.md
- CHANGELOG.md
- catalogue/routes.tsv
- tools/route_code.py
